LESSON: WOOD

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Materials for Production
Topic 3.1: Wood

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Wood. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Wood
2. Practise Wood at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Wood

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Wood
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Wood. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Wood at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Wood at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Wood
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Wood. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Wood using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Wood in the examples.
2. Explain Wood to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Wood.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Wood using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Wood important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Wood
2. Practise Wood at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Wood

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
